shellCommands.command: grep -rn "force-disabled\|prefetch" .next/server/app/product/page.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== layout ==="; grep -rn "partial\|prefetch" .next/server/app/product/layout.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo "=== / (home) ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'View Premium Widget|prefetch' | head; echo; echo "=== /product (shell + related) ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product | grep -oE 'Premium Widget|durable widget|Related products|Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related' | sort -u

echo "=== default prefetch RSC payload (no prefetch=true) ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | grep -oE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related|Related products|Premium Widget' | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo "=== full RSC payload (per-link prefetch={true} path) ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | grep -oE 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related|Related products|Premium Widget' | sort | uniq -c

echo "=== prefetch variant headers ==="; curl -sI -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | grep -iE 'content-length|x-nextjs|content-type|vary'; echo; echo "=== non-prefetch variant headers ==="; curl -sI -H 'RSC: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | grep -iE 'content-length|x-nextjs|content-type|vary'; echo; echo "=== prefetch body (first 400 bytes) ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | head -c 400; echo; echo "=== full body size ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | wc -c; echo "=== prefetch body size ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3000/product' | wc -c
find .next -name '*.json' | xargs grep -l "force-disabled\|\"partial\"" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.json' | head -20

cat .next/server/app/product/page/server-reference-manifest.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k:(v if not isinstance(v,dict) else {kk:list(v[kk].keys()) if isinstance(v[kk],dict) else v[kk] for kk in v}) for k,v in d.items()} if isinstance(d,dict) else d, indent=2)[:1500])" 2>/dev/null || cat .next/server/app/product/page/server-reference-manifest.json | head -c 1200
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE '<a[^>]*product[^>]*>' | head; echo "---data-prefetch---"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'data-n-p|prefetch' | sort | uniq -c
